recognize_zh: 視野中有一個分葉嗜中性球與一個正常小淋巴球作為大小參考，箭頭所指的小型淋巴樣細胞胞質極少、染色質濃縮，核中有一道細深的裂痕（nuclear cleft），即「臀溝細胞（buttock cell）」樣中心細胞，提示濾泡性淋巴瘤。
features: Small lymphoid cell (arrow) comparable in size to a red cell and to the adjacent normal lymphocyte
Very high N:C ratio with only a thin rim of blue cytoplasm
Condensed chromatin with a narrow linear nuclear cleft or groove
Mature segmented neutrophil and a normal round small lymphocyte in the field for comparison; red cells unremarkable
describe_en: Smear shows a mature segmented neutrophil, a normal-appearing small lymphocyte and, at the arrow, a small lymphoid cell with scant cytoplasm, condensed chromatin and a distinct linear nuclear cleft. No nucleoli, blasts or other atypical cells are present in this field, which is blood-rich and lacks marrow precursors. Findings are suggestive of a circulating or aspirated cleaved lymphoma cell (centrocyte), consistent with follicular lymphoma in context; flow cytometry for a CD10-positive, light-chain-restricted B-cell population and t(14;18) studies are recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Normal lymphocytes have a smooth round nucleus without a cleft, as illustrated by the lymphocyte beside the neutrophil.
Mantle cells may be slightly irregular but are CD5+ and cyclin D1+ with t(11;14), whereas follicular lymphoma cells are CD10+ CD5-.
ATLL cells have multilobated flower-shaped nuclei and a CD4+ CD25+ T-cell phenotype with HTLV-1 serology.
